subject: VP/CIO handshake — staggered-escort & micro-brief plan for UXBridge demo
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@uxbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: VP/CIO handshake — staggered-escort & micro-brief plan for UXBridge demo

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, we want to make the executive portion of the demo efficient for your CIO (Raj) and VP of Product (Leanne) while still giving them the context they need. Quick proposal:

- 10:00–10:10am PT: 10-minute micro-brief (private) with Raj and Leanne + our exec (Kim) — high-level outcomes and deployment ask
- 10:10–10:35am PT: Demo (recorded) with engineering stakeholders included; execs can drop after the micro-brief if they prefer
- 10:35–10:50am PT: 15-minute Q&A for technical follow-ups and procurement next steps

Logistics notes:
- We can set a staggered arrival (Raj joins at 10:00 for the micro-brief; Leanne joins 10:05 if that helps with travel).
- If either exec prefers not to be recorded for the micro-brief, we’ll stop recording until they rejoin.
- I’ve attached a short run-of-show and an exec-brief template.

Can you confirm Raj and Leanne’s preferred attendance pattern and any recording/privacy constraints? If the times above work, we’ll send an updated calendar invite with separate private briefings for the execs.

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: UXBridge-demo-runofshow-v2.pdf (pdf, 210KB); Redwood-exec-brief-template.docx (docx, 45KB)

From: Samir Patel <samir@uxbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leanne Ortiz <leanne.ortiz@uxbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VP/CIO handshake — staggered-escort & micro-brief plan for UXBridge demo

Rachel —

This plan looks sensible. Quick answers:

- Raj (CIO) can do 10:00–10:15 but needs to drop at 10:12 for an internal standup — so micro-brief needs to be tightly focused;
- Leanne (VP Product) prefers to join at 10:05 and is fine staying through the demo;
- Recording: Raj is fine with the demo being recorded but prefers the initial 5 minutes of the micro-brief to be off the record. Leanne is fine with full recording.

One ask from my side: can Kimberly (your exec) surface the high-level TCO/latency guarantees we discussed in 1 slide during the micro-brief? That will help Raj decide whether to push this forward to procurement.

I’ll loop in our procurement lead if we clear exec interest. Also, we may have our security contact on the demo for the Q&A.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Director of IT, UXBridge
(samir@uxbridge.com | +1 212-555-0199)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@uxbridge.com>, Leanne Ortiz <leanne.ortiz@uxbridge.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VP/CIO handshake — staggered-escort & micro-brief plan for UXBridge demo

Hi Samir / Leanne —

Thanks for the timing note. I’ll keep the micro-brief to five minutes and have one slide ready that covers: 1) typical token-level cost ranges for steady-state inference, 2) latency SLOs we achieve on comparable workloads, and 3) deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private) with pricing levers.

Priyom will cover the demo run and be ready for the technical Q&A.

Rachel — feel free to lock the calendar. Samir — if Raj wants the micro-brief completely off-record for the first five minutes, we’ll pause recording after introductions and resume at 10:05 when Leanne is present.

Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
(kimberly.park@redwood.ai)

Attachment: exec-slide-v1.png (image, 120KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@uxbridge.com>, Leanne Ortiz <leanne.ortiz@uxbridge.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VP/CIO handshake — staggered-escort & micro-brief plan for UXBridge demo

All set — I’ve created the calendar invite:

• 10:00–10:10am PT: Executive micro-brief (private) — attendees: Raj (CIO), Leanne (VP Product), Kimberly (Redwood)
• 10:10–10:35am PT: Full demo (recorded) — engineering + security on the call; Priyom presenting
• 10:35–10:50am PT: Technical Q&A and procurement next steps

Calendar invite includes: private micro-brief link (separate Zoom room), main demo Zoom, run-of-show and exec slide. I noted Raj’s request to keep the first five minutes off the record — we’ll pause recording and resume when Leanne joins.

Next steps / asks:
- Samir: please confirm Raj’s calendar to accept the invite or propose an alternate 30-minute block tomorrow morning if the standup conflicts;
- Leanne: any items you want called out in the micro-brief (e.g., integrations, SSO, regional data residency)?

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

Rachel
